test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 20 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Scientists have recently discovered a new species of marine life in the unexplored depths of the ocean.

options.text: A new species of marine life was recently being discovered in the unexplored depths of the ocean by scientists
A new species of marine life has recently been discovered in the unexplored depths of the ocean by scientists.
A new species of marine life had recently been discovered in the unexplored depths of the ocean by scientists.
A new species of marine life was recently discovered in the unexplored depths of the ocean by scientists.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Scientists have recently discovered a new species of marine life in the unexplored depths of the ocean."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "a new species of marine life" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "have discovered" to "has been discovered" (present perfect passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "scientists."
 
• Ensure the time phrase "recently" remains in the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"A new species of marine life has recently been discovered in the unexplored depths of the ocean by scientists."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"A new species of marine life was recently being discovered in the unexplored depths of the ocean by scientists." – Incorrect tense (past continuous passive).
 
• **Option 3: **"A new species of marine life had recently been discovered in the unexplored depths of the ocean by scientists." – Incorrect tense (past perfect passive).
 
• **Option 4: **"A new species of marine life was recently discovered in the unexplored depths of the ocean by scientists." – Incorrect tense (simple past passive).
